title: Seagrove Beach "The Long Exhale" 83 South Lake Drive
h1: Seagrove Beach "The Long Exhale" 83 South Lake Drive
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Lake views with private dock- 4 adult bikes- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Welcome to The Long Exhale! Tucked in Seagrove Beach, this stunning lakefront home offers the perfect blend of luxury and tranquility. Featuring breathtaking lake views and a private dock, this 4-bedroom, 3.5-bathroom home spans 3,000 square feet and comfortably sleeps up to 9 guests. With ample outdoor space and nearby beach access, it’s the ultimate destination for an unforgettable vacation!Serenity greets every guest from the moment of arrival. A 2-story white brick façade and cheerful teal door, framed by towering trees, set the tone for a peaceful escape. Inside, natural light dances off tall ceilings and an elegant chandelier in the spacious great room. Relaxation awaits in the living area, which features tufted furnishings and 2 cozy armchairs facing the large TV mounted above the fireplace—2 sets of French doors open wide, inviting a fresh coastal breeze inside. The open, airy layout transitions smoothly into the dining area, where a rustic live-edge table seats 8 for memorable meals. Nearby, the gourmet kitchen delights with glossy countertops, ample cabinet space, high-end appliances, and an island that doubles as a 4-person breakfast bar—perfect for entertaining while preparing meals. Sliding glass doors lead to an enclosed patio with plush furnishings and a TV overlooking the lake. Stairs guide guests down to the open deck for a closer view of the water, or an afternoon spent unwinding in the hammock. The private dock on the lake also offers comfortable seating, creating an idyllic setting for late-night cocktails and conversation. The sunlit primary bedroom features a king bed, TV, walk-in closet, and a luxurious private bathroom with a soaking tub and separate shower. A laundry room completes this floor.A sleek staircase with a modern glass railing leads to the inviting second-floor guest bedrooms with a shared bathroom, boasting 1 queen bed and 2 twin beds, respectively. Another spacious guest bedroom offers versatility, with 1 king and 1 twin bed, a TV, private bathroom, and balcony access with sweeping lake views.The Long Exhale provides everything needed for a seamless beach escape, including on-site driveway parking for 6 vehicles and 4 bikes for easy adventure. For beach access, head down South Lake Drive to Center Avenue and turn right. Next, take a left onto South Gulf Drive and follow it until reaching Eastern Lake Road. Beach access is on the left. Book now!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (SLEEPS 9):FIRST FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub SeparateSECOND FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed and Twin Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: 2 Twin Beds, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo*Guests who are 25 years of age or younger must be accompanied by a responsible parent or guardian in any vacation rental managed by Callista by 360 Blue. We do not rent homes to those 25 years of age or younger who are unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian. Moreover, there must be a ratio of at least (1) parent or guardian over the age of 25 for every four (4) young adults who are 25 years of age or younger.*The garage is not for guest use.*The sauna is not for guest use.

body_text_excerpt: Destination Travel Collections Experiences + Services About Us Homeowners Travel Blog View Gallery Seagrove Beach "The Long Exhale" 83 South Lake Drive Santa Rosa Beach, Florida Short Term Rental #STR-080654 Bedrooms 4 Beds 5 Sleeps 9 Full Baths 3 Half Baths 1 HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Lake views with private dock - 4 adult bikes - Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout DETAILS: Welcome to The Long Exhale! Tucked in Seagrove Beach, this stunning lakefront home offers the perfect blend of luxury and tranquility. Featuring breathtaking lake views and a private dock, this 4-bedroom, 3.5-bathroom home spans 3,000 square feet and comfortably sleeps up to 9 guests. With ample outdoor space and nearby beach access, it’s the ultimate destination for an unforgettable vacation! Serenity greets every guest from the moment of arrival. A 2-story white brick façade and cheerful teal door, framed by towering trees, set the tone for a peaceful escape. Inside, natural light dances off tall ceilings and an elegant chandelier in the spacious great room. Relaxation awaits in the living area, which features tufted furnishings and 2 cozy armchairs facing the large TV mounted above the fireplace—2 sets of French doors open wide, inviting a fresh coastal breeze inside. The open, airy layout transitions smoothly into the dining area, where a rustic live-edge table seats 8 for memorable meals. Nearby, the gourmet kitchen delights with glossy countertops, ample cabinet space, high-end appliances, and an island that doubles as a 4-person breakfast bar—perfect for entertaining while preparing meals. Sliding glass doors lead to an enclosed patio with plush furnishings and a TV overlooking the lake. Stairs guide guests down to the open deck for a closer view of the water, or an afternoon spent unwinding in the hammock. The private dock on the lake also offers comfortable seating, creating an idyllic setting for late-night cocktails and conversation. The sunlit primary bedroom features a king bed, TV, walk-in closet, and a luxurious private bathroom with a soaking tub and separate shower. A laundry room completes this floor. A sleek staircase with a modern glass railing leads to the inviting second-floor guest bedrooms with a shared bathroom, boasting 1 queen bed and 2 twin beds, respectively. Another spacious guest bedroom offers versatility, with 1 king and 1 twin bed, a TV, private bathroom, and balcony access with sweeping lake views. The Long Exhale provides everything needed for a seamless beach escape, including on-site driveway parking for 6 vehicles and 4 bikes for easy adventure. For beach access, head down South Lake Drive to Center Avenue and turn right. Next, take a left onto South Gulf Drive and follow it until reaching Eastern Lake Road. Beach access is on the left. Book now!
